title: The 3 Best Baby Monitors Under $100
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for baby monitors under $100, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at baby monitors under $100 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: VTech VM919HD Video Baby Monitor
products.blurb: Key specs: 7-inch 720p screen on a dedicated parent unit, No Wi-Fi, secure FHSS transmission, 360-degree pan, 100-degree tilt, 4x zoom.
strengths: 1000 ft range is the longest of any monitor in this category's roundups
No subscription and no app, so the purchase price is the only cost
limitations: No remote viewing away from home
720p resolution is softer than Wi-Fi app-based monitors
Bulkier handheld parent unit than phone-based systems
